text: Track 1.2 More and more people want to live in cities, but there are not enough houses and apartments. Town planners need to solve this problem and create more places for people to live in crowded urban areas. Today, we are going to look at one of these ways. Building homes under the ground. The idea of building places to live under the ground is not new. In fact, some very ancient cities, like the cities of Derinkuyu and Kaymakli in Turkey, were built more than 2000 years ago in caves under the mountains of Anatolia. People went into these cities to be safe in difficult times, and families lived in them with their animals for many months. People also go under the ground to get away from the weather. The Tunisian town of Matmata in the Sahara desert was built in caves hundreds of years ago for this reason. Below the ground was the best place to get away from the hot sun. More recently, in Australia, the town of Kubapedi was built in desert caves by people who came to work in the area. As we know, the weather is very hot and dry, and the caves were the most comfortable place to live. The first houses and apartments were built there in 1915, and about 3000 people still live there today. As the world gets more crowded, city buildings get taller. But how far up can we go? In some places, they have to stop building up into the sky, and the only way is down. One interesting idea came from a company in Mexico. To build a whole city under the main square in Mexico City. I think that will be a very difficult thing to do. They want to put 55 floors of offices, apartments, businesses, and shops under the city center. The 300-meter tower has a big window over the top to let in the light. There are lots of plants on every 10th floor, which help keep the air fresh and clean. Also, I personally feel that people are happier if they can see plants and trees. Another interesting idea comes from New York City, where they are building the world's first underground park. It's located in an old metro station, but it has grass and trees, just like any park. Engineers want to test new technologies for getting air and light into spaces that are under the ground. People hope that there will be enough sunlight to grow a forest.
